bias.zh: 反弹 · MACD 上穿，仍低于 $266–270

read.en: Teradyne slipped 0.8% on Nov 12 to $263.75, trading $250.00–270.73 on light volume (0.58x the 20-day average). It is above the 5-day ($247.8) and 10-day ($250.8) and below the 30-day ($323.8), 100-day ($360.2) and 200-day ($350.2); only the 200-day is rising. MACD crossed above its signal on Nov 12, below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 10 ($214.91), and RSI is 40.3.

No level changed: the $270.73 high faded back under the $266.4–269.4 Nov 3 low and close, and the $250 low held the 10-day. Resistance is $266.4–270.7, then $273.2–278 (Nov 11, 3 and 2 highs) and $296.8 (Jul 17 low). Support is $254–258, then $250–251 (10-day, Nov 12 low) and $245.9–247.8 (5-day, Nov 4 low). A close above $270.7 would target $273–278; below $254, $250.
